verdict.rationale: smolagents is a Python library that runs agents programmatically with `agent.run(...)` and no UI. It also ships CLI utilities (`smolagent`, `webagent`) for running agents without boilerplate, and supports Docker and other sandboxed execution, all of which suit headless automation. Step-by-step execution further supports long-running scripted runs. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline integration docs (e.g. GitHub Actions examples), documented non-interactive CLI flags or exit-code behavior, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
